items.prompt: A Verilog module is best described as…
choices: A named design unit with ports (and optional internal logic)
items.explain: Modules are the reusable RTL boundaries you instantiate in a hierarchy.

items.prompt: An input port on a module…
choices: Is driven from outside into the module
Is the same as a parameter
Cannot appear on a gate like and2
items.explain: Inputs are driven by the parent or testbench toward the child module.

choices: Connect formal port y to actual wire y
Delete port y from the module
Declare a new module named y
Set a parameter named y only
items.explain: Named association ties a child port name to a parent-side expression.

items.prompt: The browser lab replaces writing real Verilog you will commit.
items.explain: Track B builds literacy; Track A dot-v sketches are what you keep and synthesize.
